# Remote Work Policy — v1

**Effective Date:** January 1, 2024
**Owner:** HR Department

---

## 1. Eligibility

All full-time employees who have completed their 90-day probationary period are eligible
for remote work arrangements.

## 2. Work Hours

Employees must be available during **core hours: 9 AM – 3 PM** in their local time zone.
Outside of core hours, flexible scheduling is permitted.

## 3. Equipment Allowance

The company provides a one-time equipment stipend of **$500** for home office setup.
Receipts must be submitted within 60 days of the allowance approval.

## 4. Internet Reimbursement

Employees are eligible for internet cost reimbursement of up to **$50 per month**.
Claims must be submitted monthly via the expense portal.

## 5. Performance Review

Remote work eligibility is subject to satisfactory performance reviews. Employees
receiving a "below expectations" rating will be required to return to office.

## 6. Security Requirements

All remote employees must:
- Use company-approved VPN at all times when accessing company systems
- Encrypt their hard drive using company-provided tools
- Complete the annual security certification

## 7. Policy Review

This policy will be reviewed annually in December.
